fit: diluted Montmorency juice and exercise pain in women with fibromyalgia
assessment: Pain and day-one strength comparisons were inconclusive. The fibromyalgia questionnaire characterized participants at enrollment. The original does not report a treatment comparison for fatigue.

fit: Montmorency concentrate and perceived athletic recovery
assessment: Table 3 and the main results report inconclusive tests of perceived recovery and soreness in nine water polo players. No separate clinical fatigue comparison was reported.

fit: tart cherry drink and aggregate well-being in professional soccer players
assessment: The author abstract reports an inconclusive group-by-time effect for subjective well-being, p = .874. Full methods and any individual fatigue item or estimate remain unverified.
